# routeros_ip_arp (Resource)




<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `interface` (String) Name of the interface.

### Optional

- `___id___` (Number) <em>Resource ID type (.id / name). This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `___path___` (String) <em>Resource path for CRUD operations. This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `address` (String) IP address to be mapped.
- `comment` (String)
- `disabled` (Boolean)
- `mac_address` (String) MAC address to be mapped to.
- `published` (Boolean) Answer ARP requests for this address on behalf of the host it belongs to, so that the router replies for a host that cannot answer for itself.

### Read-Only

- `complete` (Boolean) Whether the entry has both an address and a MAC address.
- `dhcp` (Boolean) Whether the entry was created by the DHCP server.
- `dynamic` (Boolean) Configuration item created by software, not by management interface. It is not exported, and cannot be directly modified.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `invalid` (Boolean)
